name: Divided in Depth
source:
Remy decided he's been struggling alone for long enough. Today, he confesses everything to you with the wish that someone will finally listen to him.

Will your actions inspire hope or discourage his confession? What even is this secret of his, anyway?

[From [url=https://lil-beastman.itch.io/divided-in-depth]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
雷米认为他已经独自奋斗了足够长的时间。今天，他向你坦白了一切，希望最终有人能听他的。

你的行为会激发他的希望还是阻止他的坦白？他的这个秘密到底是什么？

[来自[url=https://lil-beastman.itch.io/divided-in-depth]itch.io[/url]]
